open.intake-summary: User wants to enhance the audio preprocessing module with noise reduction and effective segment extraction before voiceprint recognition, aiming to minimize LLM token usage by processing only valid speech segments.

design.design-summary: Design finalized: enhance audio preprocessing with configurable noisereduce/RNNoise denoising and silero-vad/energy VAD, add Segment metadata, and filter segments by voiceprint before downstream LLM processing. Recommend Option A (local lightweight) for MVP. Artifacts: docs/superpowers/specs/audio-preprocessing-pipeline-design.md, openspec/changes/audio-preprocessing-pipeline/specs/audio-preprocessing-pipeline/spec.md.
design.user-confirmation: User confirmed the design and Option A as the implementation approach.

plan.producer-summary: Created implementation plan at docs/superpowers/plans/audio-preprocessing-pipeline-plan.md and task contract at openspec/changes/audio-preprocessing-pipeline/tasks.md. Plan covers types extension, optional dependencies, preprocessor refactoring, segment_filter, diarization integration, config extension, pipeline update, tests, integration validation, and documentation.

execute.implementation-summary: Implemented audio preprocessing pipeline enhancement: extended Segment metadata in src/types.py, refactored src/preprocessor.py with configurable noisereduce/RNNoise/spectral denoising and silero-vad/energy VAD backends with fallback, added src/segment_filter.py for voiceprint-based segment filtering, extended src/diarization.py with filter_segments_by_voiceprint and updated identify_user metadata, updated config.yaml with preprocessing section, updated requirements.txt with optional dependencies, updated src/pipeline.py to use needs_review for low-confidence segments, updated README, added tests/test_preprocessor.py and tests/test_segment_filter.py and updated tests/test_diarization.py.

review.review-summary: Self-review of the audio preprocessing pipeline changes: Segment metadata extension is backward compatible with default values; Preprocessor supports configurable backends with graceful fallback to existing spectral/energy implementations; segment_filter and diarization integration correctly marks low-confidence segments for user correction; config.yaml defaults preserve legacy behavior; new tests cover Segment metadata, preprocessor backends/fallback, silence handling, diarization metadata, and segment_filter logic. All 51 tests pass. No blockers identified.

verify.verification-result: 54 passed, 12 warnings in 3.39s. New tests cover Segment metadata, preprocessor configurable backends with fallback, silence handling, diarization metadata/needs_review, and segment_filter voiceprint filtering.

archive.archive-summary: Archived Classic change audio-preprocessing-pipeline. Enhanced preprocessing (noisereduce + silero-vad) is now the default; legacy top-level vad/segmentation config removed. Integration test on input/test data/20260727-090126.wav: VAD found 29 segments, voiceprint filtering retained 24 target-speaker segments (486.05 s), no low-confidence segments. Core preprocessing tests pass (15/15).
